name: BetterBank FavorRouterWrapper unvalidated-pair ESTEEM bonus minting
summary: FavorRouterWrapper.swapExactTokensForFavorAndTrackBonus only checks that the path ends in a registered FAVOR token, so any token and pair qualifies, and FAVOR.logBuy credits an ESTEEM bonus on the amount bought. The attacker wash-traded FAVOR against a worthless token to farm ESTEEM, redeemed it for minted FAVOR and sold that into the official pairs.
notes: The wrapper is immutable; its only owner calls before the exploit were the three addFavorToken registrations. The later reset is PDAIF's setBonusRates(4400, 2500): at bonusRate 0 logBuy credits no ESTEEM, so the exploit needed it, and it came after setBuyWrapper and addFavorToken.

Victims are the three official FAVOR pairs (pDAI/PDAIF, PLSX/PLSXF, WPLS/PLSF), valued at the DefiLlama quote when drained (rule 14). The attacker later sold part of the pDAI for less and handed 550M pDAI back (0x51d91f49…); neither reduces gross loss.
